summary: KE Holdings Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed (Stock Code 2423) and NYSE-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing two exhibits: a notice that its board will meet on November 16, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited third-quarter 2026 results, with a management earnings call at 7:00 A.M. US Eastern Time, and a routine Hong Kong monthly return on movements in securities for October 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is an ordinary earnings-scheduling and share-capital return filing, not a special situation; watch the November 16 results and any capital-return commentary.
